morphology.pattern_note: 按英语整词处理；不能把 me- 分析为马来语前缀。所列音标为英语读音，尚未核实马来语规范读音及正式收录情况。

senses.zh_definition: 〔英语词义；马来语词条身份待核实〕蜂蜜酒，以蜂蜜和水发酵制成的含酒精饮料。
senses.en_definition: An alcoholic drink made by fermenting honey and water; an English meaning, not a verified official Malay entry.
senses.ms_definition: Minuman beralkohol yang dihasilkan melalui penapaian campuran madu dan air; huraian bagi perkataan Inggeris, bukan petikan definisi rasmi DBP.
senses.nuances: 此释义适用于英语饮料名称。缺少原始语境，不能排除输入实际来自 Mead 这一专名。所列搭配是说明性用例，未经马来语语料频率验证。[Oxford: mead](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/mead)

dual_scenarios.context: 博物馆说明 / 饮食文化介绍
dual_scenarios.ms: Pameran itu menerangkan bahawa mead dihasilkan melalui penapaian campuran madu dan air.
dual_scenarios.zh: 该展览介绍，蜂蜜酒由蜂蜜和水的混合物发酵而成。
dual_scenarios.en: The exhibition explains that mead is made by fermenting a mixture of honey and water.

dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Adakah mead ini minuman beralkohol yang dibuat daripada madu?
dual_scenarios.zh: 这个 mead 是蜂蜜酿的酒吗？
dual_scenarios.en: Is mead an alcoholic drink made from honey?

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Aku nampak mead kat menu ni. Arak madu ke?
messages.ms_standard: Saya melihat mead pada menu ini. Adakah minuman itu arak yang dibuat daripada madu?
messages.zh: 我在这份菜单上看到 mead，是蜂蜜酒吗？
messages.en: I saw mead on this menu. Is that honey wine?

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Ya, ada alkohol. Aku nak jus je.
messages.ms_standard: Ya, minuman itu mengandungi alkohol. Saya hanya mahu jus.
messages.en: Yes, it contains alcohol. I'll just have juice.

etymology.historical_story: English mead continues Old English me(o)du, a Germanic word related to German Met and Dutch mee. Its deeper relatives include Sanskrit madhu, associated with honey or a sweet drink, and Greek methu, meaning wine. This history concerns the English word; it does not establish when, or whether, Malay adopted it. [Oxford: word origin](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/mead)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 英语读音近似“米德”；想象一杯金黄蜜酒，记住 mead＝蜂蜜发酵酒。此联想不是词源。
